data.title: Utility statement 2024/25 – €184.20 due
data.summary: Muster Apartments GmbH sent the utility statement (heating and hot water) for 1 October 2024 to 30 September 2025, dated 3 November 2025. Actual costs of €1,624.20 exceeded advance payments of €1,440.00, leaving €184.20 to pay.
data.explanation: Your landlord has settled the heating and hot water costs for the past year. Your advance payments were too low, so you owe the difference of €184.20. Payment is requested within 30 days of the statement date; the app shows the exact date. Check the figures against your own records, and if anything looks wrong, ask the landlord for the itemised calculation. A tenant advice service (Mieterverein) can help if you are unsure whether the statement is correct.
